description_en: Queries the resource plan information of the current user
description_zh: 调用DescribeUserResourcePackage查询用户当前资源包信息
name: DescribeUserResourcePackage

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the resource plan
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the resource plan. Default value: valid. Valid values:
valid: Valid.
invalid: Invalid.
exhaust: Exhausted
parameters.help_zh:
资源包状态，默认值为valid。取值：
valid：有效。
invalid：无效。
exhaust：耗尽
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The sorting field. Valid values:
startTime: the effective period of the instance.
endTime: the expiration time of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
排序字段。取值：
startTime：实例生效时间。
endTime：实例失效时间
parameters.name: sort_field

parameters.help_en:
The collation. Default value: desc. Valid values:
asc
desc
parameters.help_zh:
排序规则，默认降序。取值：
asc
desc
parameters.name: sort_rule

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页参数：每页显示条数，默认值20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_zh: 分页参数：当前页码，默认值1
parameters.name: page_number

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

CommodityCode.description_en: The commodity code of the resource plan

CurrCapacity.description_en:
The current remaining capacity of the instance.
Unit for data transfer plans: Byte.

Unit for request count plans: count
CurrCapacity.description_zh:
实例当前剩余容量。
流量包单位：Byte。

请求数包单位：次

CurrCapacityBaseUnit.description_en: The base unit of the current remaining capacity of the instance
CurrCapacityBaseUnit.description_zh: 实例当前剩余容量单位

CurrCapacityShowUnit.description_en: The display unit of the current remaining capacity of the instance
CurrCapacityShowUnit.description_zh: 实例当前显示剩余容量单位

CurrCapacityShowValue.description_en: The display value of the current remaining capacity of the instance
CurrCapacityShowValue.description_zh: 实例当前显示剩余容量

DisplayName.description_en: The name of the resource plan
DisplayName.example: Data Transfer Plan in Asia Pacific 1

EndTime.description_en: The expiration time in UTC. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ
EndTime.description_zh: 失效时间（UTC时间，时间格式：YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ）

InitCapacity.description_en:
The total capacity of the resource plan.
Unit for data transfer plans: Byte.

Unit for request count plans: count
InitCapacity.description_zh:
资源包总量。
流量包单位：Byte。

请求数包单位：次

InitCapacityBaseUnit.description_en: The base unit of the total capacity of the resource plan

InitCapacityShowUnit.description_en: The display unit of the total capacity of the resource plan

InitCapacityShowValue.description_en: The display value of the total capacity of the resource plan

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the resource plan

StartTime.description_en: The effective period in UTC. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ
StartTime.description_zh: 生效时间（UTC时间，时间格式：YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ）

Status.description_en: The status of the resource plan
